reason: My Fresha page and Instagram already get people booked in, and I can tweak the Wix page myself at midnight when I'm done for the day. Pay-when-happy is a nice touch, but I don't see what a new site does that I haven't already got.
objection: It's never just the £655. It turns into £43 a month for hosting, then someone telling me I need £325 a month for SEO, and I've got one more monthly bill for something I could mostly do myself. Plus he's in Kuwait with no UK reviews, so if it breaks on a Saturday who do I actually ring?
would_change_my_mind: Hard numbers showing a local business like mine got noticeably more bookings from a proper site than from Fresha plus Instagram, from a UK owner I could actually message.
